notes: Version 1.0.0 holds the three random-forest AGB maps and the three change maps of the paper 'Integrating Multi-Source Data with Machine Learning to Estimate Forest Aboveground Biomass Dynamics in Northeast China' (Zhou Y. et al., Journal of Plant Ecology, manuscript JPE-2026-0380). Regional forest area and AGB carbon stock use valid pixels with AGB > 0 after masking and latitude-dependent WGS 84 ellipsoidal pixel areas; regional mean AGB density is area-weighted, with carbon fraction 0.50. Per-file JSON means are pixel arithmetic means for encoding QC. Existing TIFF descriptions containing 0.09 ha indicate nominal resolution, not actual pixel area. Corresponding author: Zhenggang Du (zgdu@nefu.edu.cn).
